queries_run: 貿聯-KY BizLink copper cable substitute co-packaged optics threat 2026
AI server copper cable DAC AEC vs optical CPO alternative technology disruption 2026 2027

findings.claim: CRU 預期銅雙絞線（twinax）成長延續到本十年末，但 2020 年代後期至 2030 年代初隨光學替代擴大而放緩
findings.source: CRU Group, The outlook of copper based data cables in AI data centres
findings.excerpt: Copper twinax is likely to continue growing through the end of the decade... However, growth is expected to slow in the late 2020s to early 2030s as optical substitution broadens

findings.claim: NVIDIA 表示 CPO 交換器 2026 下半年小規模部署，超大規模雲端 2026–2028 仍以可插拔光模組為主
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（聚合來源 itiger／相關轉述），Copper vs. Optical in AI Data Centers
findings.excerpt: NVIDIA has explicitly stated that its CPO switches will see small-scale deployment in the second half of 2026... hyperscale cloud providers will still primarily rely on pluggable optical modules between 2026 and 2028.

findings.claim: Gartner（2026 年 2 月）預期 CPO 約三年內成為主流，銅在 224Gbps/lane 遇到極限，買方焦點轉向 scale-up 互連
貿聯 2025-10 OCP 發表 224Gbps/lane 共封裝銅纜（CPC）並提供 CPO-ready 設計，銅與光並列為互補方案（公司新聞稿，未揭露營收占比）
findings.source: BizLink, Showcasing Complete AI and HPC Rack Solutions at OCP Global Summit 2025

substitute_technology.note: as_of 為依來源網址／摘要推得的近似月份（CRU、itiger 僅知年份）；excerpt 為 null 者搜尋摘要無逐字原文。未取得貿聯銅纜在 scale-up 的營收占比。
